test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about plant hormones?

options.text: Different plant hormones help to coordinate responses to the environment.
Different plant hormones help to coordinate growth and development.
All plant hormones except abscisic acid help in promoting growth.
All plant hormones except cytokinins promote cell division.

solution:
The correct answer is __**All plant hormones except cytokinins promote cell division.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Plant hormones, or phytohormones, play crucial roles in regulating various functions in plants.
 
• Cytokinins are known for promoting cell division and growth in plant roots and shoots.
 
• Auxins, gibberellins, and brassinosteroids also contribute to growth, but their primary roles differ from cytokinins.
 
• Abscisic acid is primarily involved in inhibiting growth and promoting dormancy, especially under stress conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Auxins**

 
 
• Auxins are primarily involved in cell elongation, apical dominance, and root initiation.
 
• They play a crucial role in the phototropism and gravitropism of plants.
 
 
 
• **Gibberellins**
 
 
• Gibberellins are essential for stem elongation, seed germination, and flowering.
 
• They help break dormancy in seeds and buds.
 
 
 
• **Ethylene**
 
 
• Ethylene is involved in the ripening of fruits and the senescence of leaves.
 
• It also plays a role in the response to mechanical stress and pathogen attack.
 
 
 
• **Brassinosteroids**
 
 
• Brassinosteroids promote cell elongation and division, vascular differentiation, and seed germination.
 
• They are also involved in stress responses.
